verdict.rationale: The evidence covers admin-side views: a stakeholder ownership cap table, clicking a stakeholder to see their profile, and an admin dashboard. It also mentions vesting email alerts for employees and investor e-signatures on SAFEs. Nothing documents an investor-facing portal where investors see their own holdings, and nothing documents structured investor updates, so this applicable axis is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a founder, my investors get their own portal view of their holdings and can receive structured updates without emailing me for the cap table
